takeaways: Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management continuously discovers devices and software, including unmanaged devices, instead of relying on periodic scans and spreadsheets.
Prioritize by context such as exploit activity, threat signals, device exposure and business role, not by CVE severity alone.
Hand remediation to Intune or a ticket system with owners and due dates, and only consider a finding closed when the device itself no longer reports the weakness.
hook: A monthly scan full of CVEs tells you what is broken, but not what to fix first. This episode explains Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management for IT and security teams, covering discovery, risk-based prioritization, remediation through Intune and verification so the riskiest gaps get closed first.
